fixed_candidate_admission_fixture.selection_rule: engine host order, then highest priority first; missing priority sorts last

full_repeat_control.equality: simulation result and equity curve digests must match

limitations: The 2016-09 through 2026-08 decade was already inspected and is diagnostic, not untouched validation.
The selected 755-security universe is survivor-universe data; this experiment does not remove survivorship bias.
All variants are gross of commission, spread, and slippage.

short_replay.proposed_repeat_equality: all three proposed replay result/equity digests must match
short_replay.timed_comparison: each arm executes its own Skill entry logic on the same warmed market-data plane

single_instrument_scope.selection: one security; original Moving Average rules and SPY downtrend gate; SPY uses its own selected price history for the gate, while QQQ uses the separately pinned SPY reference
single_instrument_scope.source: pinned SPY evidence plus QQQ evidence from the yfinance adapter

spy_benchmark.costs: same gross engine convention as strategy runs; no commission, spread, or slippage
spy_benchmark.dividends: engine credits pinned cash dividends; no reinvestment
spy_benchmark.method: single-SPY buy-and-hold through the same engine and dates
spy_benchmark.regime_filter: disabled; SPY is held continuously as the passive benchmark
spy_benchmark.valuation: split-adjusted holdings marked at as-traded close, exact pinned GBP/USD FX

policy.rtly-backtest-buy-and-hold: existing initial top-X membership and ordering

legacy.source: archived original Skill sources matching all six saved runs

proposed.source: current hashed Skill runtime, unchanged output

random.buy_and_hold: reorders only the existing selected top-X basket
